newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo rubber futures end lower on stronger yen.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo rubber futures end lower on stronger yen.

text.p: All Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Thursday, as the yen's gains against the dollar triggered selling by individual investors, traders said.
Prices were 2.6 to 3.6 yen per kg lower. The benchmark August fell to 148.8 yen in early afternoon, and was down 3.3 yen at 149.0 yen per tonne at the closing.

Local investors took profits from the opening, and the yen's gains accelerated their sell orders, traders said. The expectations of ample rubber supplies in the near term also boosted bearish sentiment, they said. "The yen/dollar rate was a driving factor today," a brokerage house trader said.
